name: Darik Wolf-Mane
source_profile: ● Darik Wolf-Mane (CN) is a young war leader who believes the Rathen must unite against Cadorian expansion. He has gathered disaffected warriors and begun harassing ranchers who establish fences across traditional routes.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 56 (source excerpt; may be partial)
